description: Lists the user's task lists: id, title, updated (RFC3339). Every task lives in exactly one list, so this is the entry point — task tools need a tasklist_id from here (or the "@default" alias for the default list). Paginate with page_token from nextPageToken; page_size caps a page at 1000 and the API's default is already 1000, so one call usually returns everything. The API has no search or ordering — filter client-side.

page_size.description: Max task lists per page (1..1000; the API's default is 1000).

name: list_tasklists
title: List task lists
